text:
marta: Hey infra, starting onboarding for a paid Dedicated customer. Need a new GCP project (rwd-onboard-2026) created + quota increases. Specific asks below.

alex: quick Qs — what's the target regions and expected steady/peak GPU counts? also which billing account to attach?

marta: regions: europe-west4 (primary), europe-west1 (benchmarks), us-west1 (fallback). Quotas: A100 80GB x8 in europe-west4, H100 x4 in europe-west1, L4 x16 in us-west1. Also need increased regional static external IP quota (30 -> 60) and increased forwarding rules (50 -> 120). Billing acct: billing-001-redwood. Estimated steady: 12 GPUs, peak 28 GPUs. Will use mix of reserved + preemptible for cost.

jamal: copying standard checklist — org admin needs to create project under org ID: 123456789012. I can open the GCP support case for quota; will need confirmation that customer data stays in eu regions (data residency).

priya: cost heads-up: assuming on-demand A100 80GB at list rate, this will be ~USD 65k/month at peak if full-time. With preemptible/reserved mix expect ~40-55% savings. Need finance sign-off before we escalate reserved buys.

chris: networking notes: we'll need VPC subnet quota increases (IPs per subnet) and Cloud NAT ephemeral port quotas if they're doing outbound at scale. Also ensure Shared VPC host project is linked or we create a dedicated VPC. Any need for Private Service Connect?

marta: yes to Shared VPC — security requires central network. Also request increase in internal IP address quota for europe-west4 (default 24 subnets) -> request 64.

alex: I'll draft the support case body. For GCP requests we should include exact gcloud snippets and expected baseline usage. Use this template: 

```bash
# project info
gcloud config set project rwd-onboard-2026
# list regional quotas
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --project=rwd-onboard-2026
```

jamal: opened support case and assigned to our Google rep. Case ID GCP-2026-004321. Quota bot generated ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/004321 (internal). Marked as "resource_increase" and requested expedited review citing enterprise contract.

quota-bot: Support case created: GCP-2026-004321. Status: OPEN. Assigned to rep jane.doe@google.com. Current SLA: 72h. Priority: P2 (expedite requested).

marta: can someone ping Jane directly? we need A100 access in europe-west4 for scheduled benchmark next week.

alex: will ping. Also note: we need IAM roles for service-accounts that will drive the fleet: compute.admin + compute.securityAdmin for infra team, plus monitoring.metricWriter for ops. Add those to the RFC.

priya: finance needs a short lift-and-shift TCO line: monthly baseline + peak + reserved commit scenarios. I can produce that if you give utilization assumptions (hours/day).

marta: assume baseline 12 GPUs 24/7, peak 28 GPUs (8 hours/day peak for first 30 days). Use preemptible for 40% of baseline.

chris: I've added a checklist item to the on-call playbook: verify cloud NAT ephemeral port ceiling and egress throughput for europe-west4 before we flip traffic. Also need firewall rules for model-serving ports (443 + 9411 internal).

jamal: updated support case with those network quota requests (external IPs, forwarding rules, subnets, NAT ports). Also included a note about region capacity: asked rep to confirm availability of H100 in europe-west1 and A100 80GB in europe-west4 — they've flagged potential supply constraints, so asked for fallback to europe-west1 for A100 if needed.

marta: thanks. Please post updates here. If Google rep asks for justification, use: "Dedicated inference fleet for enterprise customer production rollout; SLA-backed; expected 3-month retention."

alex: moving this into the infra board and adding an RFC link. If anyone has objections to the region mix or quotas, speak now.

priya: finance approved provisional spend up to $40k/month for first 60 days. For anything higher we need exec sign-off.

marta: noted — we'll try to increase preemptible share to stay under that. If quota delays happen, fallback plan is fewer benchmark replicas and more synthetic load testing.

chris: small ask — if we get H100 capacity, please tag instances with "customer:onboard-2026" and "env:bench" so billing and ops can filter.

marta: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
